title: Snapshot to tokens
outcome: Snapshot live components into a blank Paper file, then ask Claude Code via MCP to list tokens.
summary: Charles Postiaux's design-system recipe: copy shadcn components with Paper Snapshot, paste them as reference, connect Claude Code, and extract tokens.

blocks.role: Live custom components to copy from.
Browser extension that copies those components as editable layers.
Blank project the Snapshot paste lands in as reference.
Connects Claude Code to the Paper file.
Lists tokens from the pasted reference.

source.quote: Copy them with the Paper Snapshot extension. Paste them into a blank Paper project as reference. Connect Claude Code to Paper via MCP. Ask Claude to list tokens.
